term: ground-free modal reduct and independent grounding extension
definition: Extension retains one Ontic (accessibility, candidate existence and efficient causes) and adds independent world-indexed grounds. ModalAtom has existence and rigid equality atoms; ModalTruth uses the existing propositional modal Formula/Holds. SameModal requires pointwise equivalent access/existence and literal common carrier identity. No first-order quantifier language is introduced. EndpointSound and LocalFounded are separate policies. The ground relation is not Ontic.Causes.
note: Analyst framework for #545, not independently established metaphysical applicability. See docs/notes/grounding-baseline-545.md for examples, exclusions, structural properties and strongest rival replies.
